description: This file defines data models related to agent nodes, package metadata, installation specifications, process specifications, registry tracking, agent configuration, MCP server configuration, installation and run options, agent status, development options, and development status within the core domain of the agentfield project.

classes.name: AgentNode
classes.description: Represents a running agent instance with details like ID, name, port, process ID, status, lifecycle status, start time, environment variables, and log file.

classes.name: PackageMetadata
classes.description: Contains metadata information about a package such as name, version, description, author, and path.

classes.name: InstallationSpec
classes.description: Specifies configuration for package installation including source, destination, force flag, and environment variables.

classes.name: ProcessSpec
classes.description: Defines process execution parameters like command, arguments, working directory, environment variables, and log file.

classes.name: InstallationRegistry
classes.description: Tracks installed packages with a map of package names to InstalledPackage details.

classes.name: InstalledPackage
classes.description: Represents an installed package with name, version, path, environment variables, and installation timestamp.

classes.name: AgentFieldConfig
classes.description: Configuration for the agent field, including home directory, environment variables, and MCP configuration.

classes.name: MCPServer
classes.description: Represents an MCP server with name, URL, and enabled status.

classes.name: InstallOptions
classes.description: Options for package installation, including force and verbose flags.

classes.name: RunOptions
classes.description: Options for running an agent, including port and detach flag.

classes.name: RunningAgent
classes.description: Details of a currently running agent instance, including name, PID, port, status, start time, and log file.

classes.name: AgentStatus
classes.description: Status information of an agent, including name, running state, PID, port, uptime, and last seen timestamp.

classes.name: DevOptions
classes.description: Development mode options such as port, auto reload, verbosity, and watched files.

classes.name: DevStatus
classes.description: Status of development mode, including path, running state, PID, port, start time, auto reload flag, and watched files.
